 class _NamedTextIOWrapper(io.TextIOWrapper):
     def __init__(
         self, buffer: t.BinaryIO, name: str, mode: str, **kwargs: t.Any
     ) -> None:
+        self._wrapper_closed = False
         super().__init__(buffer, **kwargs)
         self._name = name
         self._mode = mode
 
+    @property
+    def closed(self) -> bool:
+        return self._wrapper_closed or super().closed
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        if self._wrapper_closed:
+            return
+
+        try:
+            self.detach()
+        finally:
+            self._wrapper_closed = True
+
+    def __del__(self) -> None:
+        try:
+            self.close()
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+
     @property
     def name(self) -> str:
         return self._name

+import gc
+import logging
 import os
 import sys
+import threading
 from io import BytesIO
 
 import pytest
 
 import click
 from click.exceptions import ClickException
+from click.testing import _NamedTextIOWrapper
 from click.testing import CliRunner
+from click.testing import StreamMixer
+
+
+def test_named_text_wrapper_close_preserves_shared_buffer():
+    buffer = BytesIO()
+    first = _NamedTextIOWrapper(buffer, "<first>", "w", encoding="utf-8")
+    second = _NamedTextIOWrapper(buffer, "<second>", "w", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    first.write("first")
+    first.close()
+    second.write("second")
+    second.close()
+
+    assert first.closed
+    assert second.closed
+    assert not buffer.closed
+    assert buffer.getvalue() == b"firstsecond"
+
+
+def test_runner_streams_survive_mixer_finalization():
+    mixer = StreamMixer()
+    streams = (mixer.stdout, mixer.stderr, mixer.output)
+    mixer.stdout.write(b"stdout")
+    mixer.stderr.write(b"stderr")
+
+    del mixer
+    gc.collect()
+
+    assert streams[0].getvalue() == b"stdout"
+    assert streams[1].getvalue() == b"stderr"
+    assert streams[2].getvalue() == b"stdoutstderr"
+
+
+def test_runner_repeated_invoke_with_retained_logging_stream():
+    logger = logging.getLogger("click.testing.lifecycle")
+    old_level = logger.level
+    old_propagate = logger.propagate
+    logger.setLevel(logging.ERROR)
+    logger.propagate = False
+    handlers = []
+
+    @click.command()
+    def cli():
+        handler = logging.StreamHandler()
+        logger.addHandler(handler)
+        handlers.append(handler)
+        thread = threading.Thread(target=logger.error, args=("logged",))
+        thread.start()
+        thread.join()
+        raise RuntimeError("failed")
+
+    runner = CliRunner()
+
+    try:
+        first = runner.invoke(cli)
+        gc.collect()
+        second = runner.invoke(cli)
+    finally:
+        for handler in handlers:
+            logger.removeHandler(handler)
+            handler.close()
+        logger.setLevel(old_level)
+        logger.propagate = old_propagate
+
+    assert isinstance(first.exception, RuntimeError)
+    assert first.stderr == "logged\n"
+    assert isinstance(second.exception, RuntimeError)
+    assert second.stderr == "logged\n"
